init_hook: curr=$PWD; while [ "$curr" != "/" ]; do if [ -d "$curr/node_modules/@prisma/engines" ]; then export PRISMA_ENGINES_DIR="$curr/node_modules/@prisma/engines"; export PRISMA_QUERY_ENGINE_LIBRARY=$(find "$PRISMA_ENGINES_DIR" -name "libquery_engine-*" | head -n 1); export PRISMA_QUERY_ENGINE_BINARY=$(find "$PRISMA_ENGINES_DIR" -name "query-engine-*" | head -n 1); break; fi; curr=$(dirname "$curr"); done

setup-all: echo '✅ Done! Environment hidden and direnv enabled.'
